name: NTA datacenter hosting ICANN L-Root instance
developer: Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority (NTA) / ICANN
notes: ICANN announced the L-Root server node was installed in Majuro; NTA provided colocation in its datacenter and bandwidth. Small internet infrastructure site; MW capacity not disclosed.

name: MiNTA core data center for fiber-to-the-home project
notes: DCD reported MiNTA planned 16 central offices, including 11 on Majuro and 5 on Ebeye, plus a new core data center; bids were open. Exact site and capacity not disclosed.

name: Eutelsat OneWeb Satellite Network Portal
developer: Eutelsat OneWeb / Marshall Islands National Telecommunications Authority (NTA)
notes: Licensing agreement for a OneWeb satellite network portal in the Marshall Islands; DCD said images suggest Laura on Majuro Atoll and the facility was expected operational by mid-2026. Treated as adjacent digital infrastructure/edge gateway, not a conventional colocation datacenter; capacity not disclosed.
